summary: LeCun argues that AI can be designed to stay safe and useful, and that systems trained only on text won’t reach human-level intelligence.

statements.quote: Ultimately, the goal is to amplify human intelligence and bring those benefits to humanity, which I think is intrinsically good.
We’re never going to get to human-level AI by just training on text. It’s just not going to happen.
It makes little sense to attribute a probability to an event on which we have agency.
The nice thing about an AI system is that you can design it in such a way that it cannot escape its guardrails.
The desire to dominate is not correlated with intelligence at all.
